Episode 63: The Mute Spectator
Keshav and Koki are informed by a lawyer that Koki's distant relative has a property worth Rs 5 crore, which could be Koki's. Keshav decides to keep a vow of silence in order to appease the Gods and get the property. But, Keshav runs into trouble with the law thanks to his vow.
